The city council approved a plan to redesign the central market square. The project will remove two lanes of traffic, add wider sidewalks and plant forty trees along the eastern edge. Shops will remain open during construction, although deliveries will be restricted to the morning. Residents have asked for more bicycle parking and a small covered stage for weekend events. The first phase is expected to begin in April and finish before the summer festival. Funding comes from the regional transport budget and a grant for urban green spaces. Officials said the final design will be published in February, and a public meeting will be held at the town hall on the first Thursday of March.
